BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat the Black Knight of Delusion!
You chased me, huh? You've got guts.\nThis will cost you your life!!
I'll avenge my brother!\nLet me join the fight!!
But...?! You'll avenge my brother?\nI got it. Good luck on your fight!
H-Hey! We've gotta run!\nI said RUN!!
Ha ha... Ha ha ha!\nLooks like you've used up all of your energy.\nIdiot!
You should have reserved your strength for\nthe finishing blow!
I knew it. It was you!\nHey! Get up!!
I...trained by attacking axe wielders to defeat\nthe Black Knight. Then you and the wandering\nknights got me and I was banished by Cipiwon...
Yea, now I remember. When I was wandering in the\nforest, I got attacked by something and I lost\nmy consciousness...
But why?! I remember everything about attacking so\nmany people! I... I... Arrrghhh!!
Hey, his armor looked like the black crystal,\ndidn't it?
Oh?! The black things are gone!
The black crystals that were covering Ruzart\nhave disappeared before you know it...\nWhat are they...?
I'll leave the rest to you...
It was a miracle.\nYou could have been dead after such a fall.\nYou're so tough, I guess.
No...When I was about to pass out from falling\ndown from the cliff, I felt someone caught me in\ntheir arms... Ouch... Well, I'm not sure...
...We'll continue our travel after his recovery.
I'm sorry for leaving the rest to you but...\nPlease bring him to justice in El Scaro.\nHe must pay for his sins...
